meta.database_name: NL Injury Tracker — Community MLB Injury Database
meta.description: A community-maintained MLB injury database for National League stars. Tracking the latest injury updates, rehab timelines, and return statuses for the NL's biggest names.

players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

types: Left hamstring strain (2nd occurrence this season)
current_injury.mechanism: Hamstring: strained running to first base. Fibula: non-displaced fracture in Spring Training.
current_injury.details: Grade 1 left hamstring strain placed on 10-day IL June 10, 2025. Began FCL rehab in July 2025. Hit a grand slam in 3rd FCL rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph exit velocity). Went 0-for-3 with a walk and 5 RBIs. Only serving as DH — NOT cleared for outfield or live baserunning. Left fibula non-displaced fracture suffered March 3, 2026 in Spring Training. On 60-day IL rehabbing since April 2026. Braves transferred Acuña and Ha-Seong Kim to Triple-A Gwinnett on July 17, 2026 for rehab assignment.
current_injury.rehab_location: FCL Braves → Triple-A Gwinnett (as of July 17, 2026)

rehab_timeline.rehab_gate_warning: Must clear cutting drills before MiLB rehab. Any setback at this stage could push return to August or later.

players.manager_quote: "He's probably as strong as he's ever been... When we turn him loose, we want him to be ready to go." — Walt Weiss (Braves manager)
players.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 torn ACL. Rehab Gate watch is critical: BP → live pitching → straight-line running → cutting → MiLB rehab → MLB activation. Guardian (Ha-Seong Kim) also transferred to Gwinnett. Home Run Derby availability remains uncertain.

latest_update.event: Cheated into Gwinnett rehab July 17. Grand slam in 3rd FCL rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph). 0-f-3, 1 walk, 5 RBIs as DH. Cutting drills NOT cleared. Expected Gwinnett stint July 18-19.

players.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.mechanism: Back stiffness not from a specific traumatic incident. Wrist soreness resolved with treatment. Residual fatigue from severe viral illness (late July 2025) causing ~25 lbs weight loss (175→150 lbs). Also experienced death of stepfather requiring personal leave.
current_injury.details: Out 3+ games as of July 13 for back stiffness. NOT expected on IL for back or wrist. Conservative day-to-day management. Resumed full workouts at Dodger Stadium. Manager Roberts: 'turned a corner' on viral recovery. New medication prescribed for stomach issues. On 7-game hitting streak with .355 avg over last 15 games.
current_injury.weight_loss: ~25 lbs during late July 2025 viral illness

rehab_timeline.expected_return: Within days (NOT IL expected for either current issue)
rehab_timeline.viral_recovery: New medication helping; full workout completed; weight stabilizing at ~150 lbs; 'turned a corner' per Roberts

players.manager_quote: "He's feeling a little better. Right now we're in a good spot — we're just managing day-to-day." — Dave Roberts (Dodgers manager)
players.notes: Most tumultuous recent stretch in recent memory: broken wrist, oblique strain (x2), severe viral illness, personal loss, back stiffness. All major injuries resolved. No IL expected. 7-game hit streak (.355 avg) shows he's at full strength. After recovery, moved to SS/3B/DH role. Lineup: Ohtani → 1B, Freeman → 2nd spot, Betts → 3rd, Tucker → 4th (cleanup).

latest_update.event: Back stiffness day-to-day; out 3+ games. 7-game hit streak (.355 avg over last 15). Home run derby. No IL expected for current issues. Weight stabilizing at 150 lbs.

players.name: Freddie Freeman
players.status: Active & Healthy; chronic ankle managed with load management

types: Chronic left ankle (managed via load management)
current_injury.mechanism: Neck stinger: from neck into right shoulder vs. Reds Aug 27. Chronic ankle: from prior sprains requiring ongoing monitoring. March 2025 rib/scar tissue episode resolved quickly during BP for Tokyo opener.
current_injury.details: No acute injury currently preventing play. Neck stinger fully resolved. Chronic left ankle from June 2025 sprain managed with load management and occasional treatment. No expected games missed. Out via Thursday vs Reds with neck stinger; returned Friday with no lingering effects. Freeman: 'I feel confident he can get through it and won't have any setbacks.'
current_injury.management: Load management with rest days; occasional flare-ups monitored

recent_form.notable_milestone: 2024 WS MVP: Walk-Off Grand Slam, .280/.355/.565, 9 HR, 36 RBI, 25 SB
recent_form.2025_projection: 30 SB in first 300 ABs, 25.9% walk rate, leading MLB in softball grounds

rehab_timeline.expected_return: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly
rehab_timeline.ankle_management: Ongoing with load management; occasional flare-ups monitored

injury_history.return_status: Returned; played through 2024 postseason, WS MVP

players.manager_quote: "I feel confident he can get through it and won't have any setbacks. There's still some kind of lingering effects, but nothing compromising." — Dave Roberts (Dodgers manager)
players.notes: Most durable of the three tracked players historically. Chronic ankle issues (right debridement Dec 2024, left sprain Jun 2025) require ongoing monitoring. Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 World Series despite injuries is legendary. No games missed in 2025 due to injury currently. Most at risk: right ankle (post-debridement) and chronic ankle over a long season.

latest_update.event: Out vs. Reds Wednesday with neck stinger (neck into right shoulder). Returned to lineup Friday with no lingering effects. Currently playing with chronic ankle managed via load management.

active_injuries.acuna: The only NL star currently on the IL. Hamstring strain recurring + fibula fracture. Rehabbing in Gwinnett. Critical gate: cutting drills.
active_injuries.betts: Day-to-day with stiff lower back. No IL expected. 7-game hit streak shows full health.
active_injuries.freeman: No acute injury. Chronic ankle managed with load management. Fully active.

priority_ranking.priority: MEDIUM — Day-to-day back tracking + post-viral updates
